subject: Altimeter — capacity & term check-in (Q2 usage + next steps)
messages:
From: Sarah Lindstrom <sarah@altimeterhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Altimeter — upcoming contract & capacity check-in

Markus,

Quick note from my side: Q2 finished a bit ahead of our internal forecast and token consumption is running ~28% above the commit we put in place last year. I pulled a short snapshot (attached) showing week-over-week spikes tied to a new feature rollout.

Can we do a short check-in on:
- Current token run-rate vs committed monthly baseline
- Any optimizations (batching / quantization recommendations) that would materially change cost
- Options for temporary burst credits or a short-term uplift to Dedicated capacity while we stabilize the release

Procurement (cc: Tom Hayes) will need a sense of term/price changes if we move capacity up ahead of renewal. Looking for a 30–45 minute sync next week if that works.

Attachments: usage_snapshot_q2.csv (CSV, 78KB)

Thanks —
Sarah Lindstrom
Head of Platform
Altimeter Health

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lindstrom <sarah@altimeterhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Altimeter — upcoming contract & capacity check-in

Hi Sarah — thanks for the snapshot, I reviewed the CSV and pulled together a short ops/ROI note (attached). Summary up-front:

- Run-rate: your rolling 30-day token burn implies a projected monthly spend ~26% above current committed tier if usage holds. The main driver is a +120% spike in inference calls for the new feature window.
- Performance: 99th percentile latency remains within your SLO on hosted, but sustained spikes are increasing tail latency during peak windows.
- Opportunities: a combination of temporary Dedicated headroom + enabling model-level KV prefix caching for the hot paths would reduce cost per token by ~9–12% and reduce tail latency.

Options we recommend (short list):
1) Pilot Dedicated uplift (2 reserved GPUs) for 6 weeks to absorb peak traffic and measure actual tail-latency improvement — we can price this as a committed add-on with a 10% onboarding credit.
2) Apply quantization profile for the generator model in non-critical regions (we estimate ~8% token-cost saving with no meaningful quality drop in your tests).
3) Grant a one-time burst credit pool to smooth billing while we validate option (1).

Next steps I propose: 30-minute sync with you + Tom (procurement) + Kimberly (pricing) to go over a formal terms adjustment and a draft SOW for the Dedicated pilot. Kimberly, I looped you for pricing/term trade-offs and Laura for operational runbook alignment if we proceed.

I attached a short ops brief: redwood-q2-ops-brief.pdf (contains the cost model and suggested pilot SLOs).

Available windows: Wed 7/3 9–11am PT, Thu 7/4 2–4pm PT, Tue 7/9 10–12pm PT. Tell me what works and we’ll confirm.

--
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lindstrom <sarah@altimeterhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@altimeterhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Altimeter — upcoming contract & capacity check-in

Markus — appreciate the fast turn. Thanks to you and the team for the ops brief, that’s helpful. Tom (procurement) added two asks in-line:

1) Formal quote and a clean SOW for the 6-week Dedicated pilot (we need deliverables, acceptance criteria, and rollback terms).
2) A PO template so we can get approval routed quickly on our side — attaching our standard procurement template for completeness.

We can take Tue 7/9 10am PT. On the price side: our legal team will need to review any term changes, but a capped uplift with a timebox on the pilot is likely to be acceptable. Can you include the 10% onboarding credit in the quote?

Forwarded attachment: altimeter-po-template.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Onwards —
Sarah

Sarah / Tom — thanks, and good to meet on Tuesday. Follow-up items from our side before the call:

- I asked Kimberly to draft a formal quote + short SOW for a 6-week Dedicated pilot (2x A100-equivalent nodes) with the 10% onboarding credit reflected. Kimberly, will you include acceptance criteria (latency targets, percent reduction in tail latency) and a rollback clause?
- Laura will prepare an operations runbook and a migration checklist for lifting traffic to Dedicated.

See you Tue 7/9 10am PT — calendar invite to follow.
